worlds.name: Alfheim
worlds.blurb: On the blue world of Urth, orbited by the shattered moon Iron Heart, the epoch of castles and steel has lingered for centuries. Alfheim is its largest continent, a diverse tapestry of kingdoms poised between the primordial past and the machine age, still ruled by magic and mystery. Human culture has been decimated by the undead serpent god Sett, King Henryk is missing, the dwarf-city Iradrum lies in ruin, Snow Orcs and Elves are on the march, and the star-faring Tortons have arrived as refugees, dragging this fantasy world into a wider cosmic conflict.

worlds.name: Warp Shell
worlds.blurb: Eons beyond the kingdoms of Alfheim, in a universe crumbling under the appetite of a god-like Devourer, a species of living starships called WARP SHELLs fold space and time with limitless psychic power. Enhanced with Xevosian technology, these arthropod vessels CHOOSE their crews, waking them from cryo sleep en route to critical battles and branching timelines. Their numbers thinned by the Broken Sword tragedy and one shell driven mad, a handful still move between dimensions while their intrepid crews fight the cold-minded Xevosians and race to save all of existence.

lifeForms.name: Human
lifeForms.desc: The great city of Grey was once the seat of humankind, now mostly ruin after the serpent armies of Sett, leaving humans a dwindling minority hunted by elves. Despite this there is strength and resolve in their blood, a will to rise again.

lifeForms.name: Dwarf
lifeForms.desc: The durable 'stout folk' have flourished in this new age. The destruction of Iradrum and disappearance of their ancient enemy Durathrax bolstered their resolve; they stand as a vast, unified force in Ramthas and Duradin, ready to war over the overtaken lands of Skar.

lifeForms.name: Elf
lifeForms.desc: Once confined to Aphos, the Elves have become an invading force of terrible power in the North, decimating the peoples of Skar. Not all are tyrants, and their dissidents are growing in number, betraying their misguided leaders to join the resistance.

lifeForms.name: Torton
lifeForms.desc: A stream of turtle-like Torton refugees has been arriving at Xenos, Kath, and Duradin, some seeming to appear from thin air. Their fate is bound to the vanishing WARP SHELLs, and they possess an intuitive sense for magic, having traversed vast dimensions of space to build a home here.

lifeForms.name: Gerblin
lifeForms.desc: The warrior queen of Thushum has shifted the Gerblin way of life to one of nobility and good, each bound by a blood oath and code of honor. Inventive and adept, they stand at the forefront of Alfemic firearm technology and a looming war with the elves of Skar.

lifeForms.name: Geno
lifeForms.desc: Once called 'Human,' a vast population of Genos is scattered across the stars. Engineered by Psykers eons ago, they far outgrew their creators' intent to become a diverse, adaptable life form found mixed into every crew and culture in the multiverse.

lifeForms.name: Xill
lifeForms.desc: One of the strangest species in existence, the enigmatic Xill are silicate life forms of variable-state matter fluctuating between liquid and solid. Their thoughts and technology are so foreign they are considered invaders one year and allies the next; a rare few interact with other species, often bearing dire portents.

lifeForms.name: Reptoid
lifeForms.statBonus: CLAW WEAPONS, walk on any surface
lifeForms.desc: The Reptoids are growing in power, fueled by the evil of a Dark Star, causing a schism in their culture. A resistance in the Reptoid civil war takes to the stars in search of answers, hoping to free their misguided kin from the Dark Star's influence.

lifeForms.name: Kitt
lifeForms.desc: Safe from the Xevosian wars by distance, the Kitt evolved in relative isolation until now. A resourceful, noble folk new to the cosmic scene, their quickness is without peer, making them effective pilots and gunfighters. Optional 'Lil' Guys' rules let a Kitt start with 5 HP but fit in tiny spaces, equip a micro jetpack, or have heightened senses.

lifeForms.name: Mecha
lifeForms.desc: Far beyond mere 'robots,' the Mecha are advanced machine species whose internal systems have reached a complexity that can only be called life. Their forms vary widely, from boxy maintenance frames to elegant bipeds, and their role in the cosmos is driven by a misunderstood identity.

lifeForms.name: Ghost Armor
lifeForms.desc: Former slave warriors of the defeated Imperium, all Ghost Armors share a motivation to escape and destroy what remains of their masters. The ghosts contained in these suits are supernatural entities, and it falls to them to show the universe that Ghost Armors are a legitimate form of life.

types.name: Warrior
types.desc: A master of steel who can take a beating.
startingLoot: Weapon Gem: Customize any 1 WEAPON with a special counterweight, giving it a +2 EFFORT bonus. The gem cannot be removed.
Shield Glove: A strapped glove and belt harness for carrying shields; shields occupy no space in your INVENTORY.
Battle Standard: A tabard or banner with your inspiring war insignia. Choose 1 ally per ROUND; their next roll is EASY.

types.name: Hunter
types.desc: A marksman with a knack for survival.
startingLoot: Crystal Scope: Attach to any 1 ranged WEAPON; never roll HARD to hit with that WEAPON.
Arcane Cartridge: An enchanted steel sleeve imbues your ammunition with magic; your shots inflict ENERGY damage.
Trap Launcher: A spring-loaded gadget; roll a ranged attack to place a trap anywhere you can see.

types.name: Shadow
types.desc: A master of stealth and subterfuge.
startingLoot: Dagger Kit: A set of three masterwork blades that score critical hits on natural 18, 19, or 20 rolls.
Spider Claws: Special clawed gloves that let you move as normal on any surface, including ceilings.
Pocket Cloak: A cloak with 2 versions: treat all CARRIED inventory spaces as EQUIPPED, or add 10 CARRIED spaces.

types.name: Bard
startingLoot: Fine Instrument: Your Battle Hymns grant each ally a D8 to boost any 1 roll.
Heirloom: Your weapon is a treasure; always do ULTIMATE when dueling.
Reverse Cloak: A modular costume cape; your fibs last 2D4 ROUNDS.

types.name: Mage
types.desc: A collector and conduit of arcane secrets.
startingLoot: Astral Grimoire: Your SPELL book is drawn to you by a subtle kinetic force. Gain any 3 INT SPELLS instantly; the book slides toward you if it can.
Memory Ring: Gain any 3 INT SPELLS. On any TURN when not casting, roll 1D6 and keep it for later use on any 1 roll; store up to 6D6.
The Master's Skull: A small demonic skull; fill with blood to store 10 HP, used to heal or as part of your Dark Pact ability.

types.name: Priest
types.desc: A righteous avatar of divine might.
startingLoot: Greenstaff: Store elemental magic in a wooden staff. Gain any 3 WIS SPELLS instantly; if lost, it comically turns up in 1D4 ROUNDS.
Book of Truths: A tome of religious texts. Gain any 5 WIS SPELLS instantly, but if lost or destroyed the SPELLS are gone.
Amber Beads: A necklace giving focus. Gain any 1 WIS SPELL that dwells within the beads and only fails on a natural 1.

types.name: Pilot
types.desc: A headstrong daredevil with rare skill.
startingLoot: Hot Rod: A super-compact starship seating up to 6, with no weapons or shields, just tiny and fast as hell.
Speed Holster: Draw a pistol with impossible speed; if an enemy attacks you for the first time, roll 1 free pistol attack against them first.
HUD Goggles: Hypertech optics track a target; the selected target cannot be lost until you designate a new one, across vast distance and even time.

types.name: Gunner
types.desc: The one you call to blow things up.
startingLoot: Burst Module: Attack rolls of modified 15+ earn you another attack.
Reflex Bipod: Your aimed shots only miss on a natural 1.
Explosives Kit: Modify a single gun so its shots explode on contact, damaging a NEAR radius. If empty, lost, or destroyed, spend 1 ROUND to modify a new gun.

types.name: Mechanic
types.desc: An expert on every nut and bolt in space.
startingLoot: Omnitool: An arc-welder that repairs any machine with ENERGY EFFORT.
Lil Bob: Twin-stick controller and micro camera on a foldable drone; use the drone's location as your location for repair, tune, or jerry rig actions.
Diagnostic Computer: Access lock codes, camera footage, computer files, and magnetic strip codes with an INT roll.

types.name: Navigator
types.desc: A psychic link to the cosmos.
startingLoot: Xevosian Starmap: A wrist-worn megacomputer that cuts all deep space travel times in half, even on a tiny scale such as a dogfight.
Boost Helmet: Focus your will to use any STAT as STR.
Psionic Knives: Make thought into energy at will, forming an ENERGY melee weapon that can never be lost, detected, or damaged; usable by you or your telekinetic presence.

types.name: Scientist
types.desc: A disciplined mind set on answers.
startingLoot: Advanced Scan Unit: Use 1 TURN to run a scan, reducing the current TARGET by 1D4 for you and your allies.
Extra Limb: A third arm for work; when doing non-damage EFFORT on machinery, repairs, or building, always roll ULTIMATE.
Genome Taser: A NEAR range electrical weapon useful only against biological life; always roll ULTIMATE, but at 0 HP the target is stunned, not dead.

types.name: Echo
types.desc: The quantum results of time distortion.
startingLoot: Divider Unit: When changing forms, you can also separate in half; both halves move and act, but your turn still only has 1 main ACTION.
Pocket Door: When you move, choose to create a tiny wormhole; other creatures can use this doorway to make your same move for 1 ROUND.
Relay Ray: Any time you use a starting ABILITY, gain 1D8 ENERGY stored.

abilities.name: Slayer
abilities.desc: If attacking an enemy you have already harmed, do ULTIMATE damage.

abilities.name: Defender
abilities.desc: Allies within CLOSE range of you may use your DEFENSE STAT.

abilities.name: Pit Fighter
abilities.desc: When you take damage, add the amount of the last hit against you to the next hit you make.

abilities.name: Quick Draw
abilities.desc: On a ranged attack roll of modified 15+, fire again.

abilities.name: Dead Eye
abilities.desc: Use one TURN to aim; your next successful hit deals max damage.

abilities.name: Trap Expert
abilities.desc: Your traps damage all victims NEAR the trap when tripped.

abilities.name: Assassin
abilities.desc: If a target doesn't know you're there, your first attack cannot miss.

abilities.name: Thief
abilities.desc: Your stealth rolls are always EASY.

abilities.name: Scout
abilities.desc: When using WIS to seek out details or hidden truths, roll EASY.

abilities.name: Battle Hymn
abilities.desc: Provide music with a CHA roll to reduce allies' TARGET by 2.

abilities.name: Provoker
abilities.desc: Hurl insults at any 1 enemy; they cannot resist dueling with you.

abilities.name: Thespian
abilities.desc: With a CHA roll, convince subjects of even wildly ridiculous fibs; their belief lasts 1D4 ROUNDS per roll made.

abilities.name: Spell Scholar
abilities.desc: If you find a written SPELL, gain an extra SPELL.

abilities.name: Wild Power
abilities.desc: Any time you roll a max die, roll it again.

abilities.name: Dark Pact
abilities.desc: Sacrifice any amount of your HP to boost any 1 roll.

abilities.name: Elemental
abilities.desc: Nature or weather magic is always EASY to cast.

abilities.name: Healer
abilities.desc: Any healing magic you cast does ULTIMATE EFFORT.

abilities.name: Monk
abilities.desc: Use your WIS STAT when making unarmed attacks.

abilities.name: Ace
abilities.desc: Only crash a small or medium ship on a natural 1 piloting roll.

abilities.name: Smuggler
abilities.desc: Your carried LOOT is undetectable and cannot be lost or stolen.

abilities.name: Cap'n
abilities.desc: Invent and execute maneuvers with a huge or capital starship, even without crew; with crew present, only fail on a natural 1.

abilities.name: MG Specialist
abilities.desc: Attacks unleash 1D4 shots, but guns empty on a natural 5 or less.

abilities.name: Sharpshooter
abilities.desc: Use a TURN to take aim; your next shot does ULTIMATE.

abilities.name: Demolitions
abilities.desc: Double all damage against vehicles, objects, or structures.

abilities.name: Repairman
abilities.desc: Any roll involving repair is always EASY.

abilities.name: Jerry Rigger
abilities.desc: Combine two machines to perform a hybrid function reliably with an INT roll; the gadget functions for 1D6 ROUNDS.

abilities.name: Tuner
abilities.desc: Adjust any machine to do 1 category of EFFORT better than it currently does, once per machine, with an INT roll.

abilities.name: Farseer
abilities.desc: With a WIS roll, locate any critical destination.

abilities.name: Telekinetic
abilities.desc: With an INT roll, extend your STR up to FAR range.

abilities.name: Infiltrator
abilities.desc: Become invisible by winning a WIS roll against those who would detect you; those who fail cannot detect you for the entire encounter.

abilities.name: Analysis
abilities.desc: When you use a Scan Unit for an investigate action, use no time.

abilities.name: Engineering
abilities.desc: Any time you work on machines, the roll is EASY.

abilities.name: Xenobiology
abilities.desc: Identify the properties of any creature with an INT roll.

abilities.name: Changer
abilities.desc: With a CON roll, change your form into any solid shape, liquid, or gas.

abilities.name: Blip
abilities.desc: When you move, you don't pass through the space between locations.

abilities.name: Energy Star
abilities.desc: Roll CON to harvest 1D10 ENERGY from any NEAR source and deliver it as healing EFFORT or as a bonus to any roll in the following ROUND.

abilities.name: Blip Module
abilities.desc: A phase-movement augment: when you move, you do not pass through the space between the two locations.

abilities.name: Cybernetics Loadout
abilities.desc: Your limbs and skeleton are augmented with nano fibers and duranium scaffolds; all forms of blunt impact inflict no damage.

abilities.name: Zurin Symbiote
abilities.desc: The Zurin primordial form, a tiny organism that binds to the spinal cord and enhances subtle empathy; 'Don't Die on me, man!' rolls are always EASY.

abilities.name: Jump Pack
abilities.desc: A miniaturized ion thruster worn as a small backpack; move twice on your TURN, even when taking an action or making an attack.
